installApp.question: How can I install the app?
installApp.answer:
To install the Summits app, it depends on your operating system (iOS or Android) or the browser version you use.

Below you'll find the install button and steps according to your device (as we do on the landing page, but with a simpler design)

newPeaks.question: New route peaks don't appear
newPeaks.answer:
If the most recent peaks from your routes don't appear, try using the button on the home screen (top right) that says "Load more peaks".

If this doesn't work or there's any error, you can contact me from your profile, in the "Contact developer" section.

incorrectPeaks.question: It shows I've climbed peaks I haven't actually climbed (or vice versa)
incorrectPeaks.answer:
To calculate your peaks, the app checks the coordinates of your routes and determines the points you've passed through.

Due to the low accuracy of altitude, it's not always possible to establish with certainty whether you've climbed a peak or simply passed near or below it. This can happen especially in areas with high peak density, like Montserrat, where it may seem you've climbed peaks you actually haven't.

In the opposite case —if you think you've climbed a peak but it doesn't appear—, it's possible that the GPS failed or recorded the route with a small margin of error. I recommend viewing your route on the map and checking the line that the GPS recorded.

If you still think it's an error, you can contact me from the "Contact developer" section in your profile.

missingRoutes.question: Not all my routes or new routes I've done appear
missingRoutes.answer:
To avoid analyzing routes unnecessarily, Summits only analyzes routes from specific categories related to mountain activities (hiking, mountaineering, trail running...). This way, it avoids a large load of routes and doesn't analyze those that very likely don't have any mountain activity such as: swimming, running, cycling, gym...

To ensure your routes will be analyzed, check that they have a valid type. If you have any problems related to this, you can contact me in the "Contact developer" section.

terms.title: Summits – Terms of Service (External Platform Data Usage)

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Summits is a platform that helps track and share mountain peak climbing experiences. To provide this service, Summits integrates with third-party platforms including Garmin Connect, Strava, and Wikiloc (collectively, "External Platforms") to import and analyze your outdoor activity data. By using Summits and registering with your External Platform accounts, you agree to these Terms of Service regarding the use of your data.

whatData.title: 1.1 What Data We Access
whatData.intro: When you connect your External Platform accounts to Summits, we access the following types of data:

wikiloc.activity: Activity and route data (GPX files, tracklogs)

strava.activity: Activity data including routes and tracks
strava.elevation: Elevation gain, distance, and duration metrics
strava.profile: Basic profile information (name, username, profile photo)

garmin.profile: Basic profile information (name, username, profile photo)

howWeUse.title: 1.2 How We Use Your Data
howWeUse.intro: We use data from External Platforms to:
howWeUse.identifyPeaks: Identify which mountain peaks you have climbed
howWeUse.displayHistory: Display your climbing history on interactive maps
howWeUse.calculateStats: Calculate your total peaks climbed and other statistics
howWeUse.enableSharing: Enable sharing of achievements with other users (subject to privacy settings)
howWeUse.leaderboards: Include your statistics in community leaderboards
howWeUse.analyzeRoutes: Analyze and store your routes with identified peaks

compliance.intro: By connecting your External Platform accounts to Summits, you acknowledge that:
compliance.readAgree: You have read and agree to comply with each platform's Terms of Service
compliance.apiTerms: We access your data only according to permissions you grant and each platform's API terms
compliance.devPolicies: We comply with Garmin's, Strava's, and Wikiloc's developer and privacy policies
compliance.noCredentials: We do not share your login credentials

scope.intro: By authorizing Summits, you grant permission to:
scope.readStore: Read, store, and process your activity data
scope.analyzeTransform: Analyze and transform your data to identify peaks

revocation.title: 2.3 Revocation of Access
revocation.content: You may revoke Summits access at any time via your External Platform account settings. Once revoked, no new data will be imported. Previously imported data remains unless you request deletion.

retention.active: Imported data is stored while your Summits account is active.
retention.deleted: Deleted accounts and data are permanently erased within 30 days.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Summits ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website (collectively, the "Service"). By using the Service, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.

dataController.title: 2. Data Controller
dataController.content: The data controller responsible for your personal information is:

personalData.title: 3.1 Personal Information
personalData.intro: When you create an account, we collect:

activityData.title: 3.2 Activity Data from Third-Party Platforms
activityData.intro: When you connect your accounts from Wikiloc, Strava, or Garmin, we collect:

wikiloc.timestamps: Activity timestamps (start time, end time, duration)

strava.timestamps: Activity timestamps (start time, end time, duration)

garmin.elevation: Elevation data and heart rate information

technicalData.title: 3.3 Technical Information
technicalData.device: Device information (device type, operating system, unique device identifiers)

purposes.title: 4.1 Purposes of Processing
purposes.peakIdentification: Identify peaks you have completed from your activity data
purposes.progress: Track your progress and generate statistics
purposes.statistics: Calculate and display your personal statistics and achievements
purposes.community: Enable social features, leaderboards, and community interactions
purposes.communication: Send you notifications, updates, and support communications
purposes.improvement: Improve, personalize, and develop the Service
purposes.security: Detect, prevent, and address technical issues and security threats

legalBasis.title: 4.2 Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: We process your personal data based on:
legalBasis.consent: Your consent when you connect third-party accounts
legalBasis.contract: Performance of our contract with you to provide the Service
legalBasis.legitimate: Our legitimate interests in operating and improving the Service

thirdParties.title: 5.1 Third-Party Service Providers
thirdParties.intro: We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in:

publicData.title: 5.2 Public Information
publicData.intro: The following information may be publicly visible:
publicData.profile: Public profile information you choose to share

legal.title: 5.3 Legal Requirements
legal.content: We may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or governmental authority, or to protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users.

location.title: 6.1 Data Location
location.content: Your data is stored on secure servers located in the European Union and United States. By using the Service, you consent to the transfer of your data to these locations.

retention.title: 6.2 Data Retention
retention.active: While your account is active and for as long as necessary to provide the Service
retention.deleted: For up to 30 days after account deletion, after which it is permanently removed
retention.legal: As required by applicable laws and regulations

security.title: 6.3 Security Measures
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
security.encryption: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
security.infrastructure: Secure infrastructure and regular security audits

access.title: 7.1 Right to Access
access.content: You have the right to request access to your personal data and receive a copy of the data we hold about you.

rectification.title: 7.2 Right to Rectification
rectification.content: You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.

erasure.title: 7.3 Right to Erasure
erasure.content: You can request deletion of your personal data. You may delete your account at any time through the app settings.

restriction.title: 7.4 Right to Restriction
restriction.content: You can request restriction of processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.

portability.title: 7.5 Right to Data Portability
portability.content: You can request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

objection.title: 7.6 Right to Object
objection.content: You can object to processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests.

withdraw.title: 7.7 Right to Withdraw Consent
withdraw.content: You can withdraw your consent at any time by disconnecting third-party accounts or deleting your account.

complaint.title: 7.8 Right to Lodge a Complaint
complaint.content: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority if you believe your rights have been violated.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service and store certain information.

types.title: 8.1 Types of Cookies
types.essential: Essential cookies required for the Service to function
types.analytics: Analytics cookies to understand how users interact with the Service
types.functional: Functional cookies to remember your preferences

management.title: 8.2 Cookie Management
management.content: You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect the functionality of the Service.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our Service can be used by children of all ages. We are committed to protecting the privacy of children and all users. We implement appropriate safeguards to ensure the safety and privacy of children using our Service. If you have any concerns about your child's use of our Service, please contact us.

international.title: 10. International Data Transfers
international.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. These countries may have data protection laws that differ from those in your country. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your data.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:
contact.support: Support: Available via in-app help and support features
